decisions.reason: As a very recent launch that is close to the firm's existing heat-exchanger capabilities, it is likely to be retained while management waits for clearer market feedback rather than reacting prematurely under uncertainty.

Management would likely keep this new condenser on the market for another year because there is no clear evidence of performance below aspiration, although some rationalization risk exists given overlap with similar offerings.

Because it is newly introduced and closely related to the firm's core engineering business, the firm would usually continue it unless clear underperformance emerges, even if it partly overlaps with comparable products.
This repair-oriented product fits an established industrial aftermarket niche, so a mature German machinery firm would likely tolerate uncertain early sales and keep it in place.
A customized industrial air cooler matches the firm's probable strength in tailored machinery solutions, making continued market presence more likely while demand is still being learned.
As an adjacent maintenance and repair solution using existing know-how, it would likely be kept because the firm can support it with relatively little additional search or resource strain.
